remarks: Looking for a spacious single-story home with two primary suites? Welcome home! With approximately 2,500 square feet all on one level, this 4-bedroom home is full of well-designed, thoughtfully planned spaces. Both primary suites offer privacy, spacious closets, private en-suite baths, and direct access to the laundry. Off one primary suite is a private retreat ideal as a library, media room, or second living room. The front primary suite has its own private entrance, giving it the feel of a separate guest suite.
